title: Wither Ascension
description: Makes the Wither boss harder with phases and abilities
body:
# Wither Ascension

The vanilla Wither dies in about 30 seconds and never really fights back. **Wither
Ascension** turns it into a real boss battle — a cinematic, multi-stage duel with
loads of attacks, smart AI, a craftable counter-weapon, a world that twists around
you, and a secret rematch if you're fast enough.

> Heads up: this is a hard fight. Bring good gear, potions, and maybe a friend.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/VtJu1njmrWY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---

## What's different from the normal Wither?

- **Four stages instead of one** — the Wither changes how it fights as its health drops.
- **15+ attacks** — beams, chains, clones, black holes, lightning, slams, summons, and more.
- **Every big move warns you** — a message and effects tell you what's coming so you can react.
- **It actually moves and thinks** — it chases you, dodges your hits, and punishes you for running away.
- **A counter-weapon** — forge the Wither-Bane Blade to stun it and finally land your hits.
- **The world fights too** — the ground around you slowly corrupts into soul sand and blackstone.
- **A secret second phase** — kill it fast enough and it refuses to stay dead.

---

## The Fight

- **Awakening (start):** The Wither is dormant for a few seconds — a spiral of souls,
  thunder, and a starting shockwave. Don't get close yet.
- **Stage 1 (100%–50%):** It tests you with a rotating mix of attacks.
- **Stage 2 (50%–33%):** It roars, calls minions, and unlocks nastier moves like the
  Soul Beam and Shadow Clone. Arrows near it get destroyed.
- **Stage 3 (below 33%):** Enrage. The deadliest attacks come out, and it speeds up.
- **Final Stand (below 30%):** It gets stronger and faster for one last push. Burst it down.

---

## Attacks you'll face

- **Soul Beam** — charges up, then sweeps a beam. Hide behind a wall to avoid it.
- **Soul Chains** — tethers you to it; run away to break free or take a big hit.
- **Shadow Clone** — it turns invisible and spawns 3 fake glowing copies. Find the real one.
- **Soul Storm** — 8 orbs orbit it and occasionally shoot a homing soul at you.
- **Black Hole** — pulls you in, then explodes. Run!
- **Charge / Slam** — dashes through blocks, or leaps and slams down with a shockwave.
- **Pull / Pulse / Rage** — yanks you in, knocks you back, or blasts you.
- **Lightning Storm / Minions / Skull barrages** — rain, skeletons, and falling skulls.
- **Corrupted Ground** — purple clouds that slow and hurt you if you stand in them.

---

## How do I win?

1. **Forge the Wither-Bane Blade first** (drop a Netherite Sword next to a Withered
   Core). Hit the Wither with it to stun it for 8 seconds — that's your window to deal
   damage, because otherwise it dodges melee.
2. **Watch the warnings.** Every dangerous move tells you what to do: break sight,
   run, or hide.
3. **Don't camp.** It shoots skulls at runners and drops magma / lightning on kiters.
4. **Keep moving.** The ground turns hostile and the fog thickens the longer you take.
5. **Pop it in Stage 3.** Save your best stuff for the enrage and end it fast.

---

## Death, Trophies & a Secret

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d2520f959c97ad5500896e5488fc47bd58b1fa4.png)

Beating it plays a short death scene and drops a **Wither Trophy** that boosts your
reach and damage. Killing it more times unlocks milestone trophies (5 / 25 / 100
kills). And if you finish it in **under 5 minutes**, it comes back as **"The Unbroken"**
— a faster, stronger rematch.

---

## Installation

1. Download and drop the `.zip` into your world's `datapacks/` folder.
2. Load the world (or run `/reload`); enable it in **World Settings → Data Packs**.

# Recommended Resource Pack

For the best experience, use the [Remastered Wither](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/remastered-wither) resource pack with this datapack.
   
## Requirements

- **Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.x.**
- No mods needed — it's a plain vanilla datapack.
- Works in singleplayer and multiplayer; multiple Withers can be active at once.
